# Architecture to Autonomy

> Practical blueprints on enterprise architecture, AI strategy, cloud modernization, and agentic AI systems.

Author: Samir Roshan
Site: https://architecturetoautonomy.com/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/samirroshan/
GitHub: https://github.com/code4freedom

## Posts

- [VCF 9.1 is Out. What Does This Mean to You?](https://architecturetoautonomy.com/posts/vcf-9-1-what-does-this-mean-to-you.html): Six practical situations VCF 9.1 addresses — memory tiering, GPU pooling, SDN/fabric coordination, agent hosting, drift remediation, and a governed data tier — and why this release is the stepping stone to the agentic enterprise platform.
- [The Seam: Where Classical EA Meets Agentic Governance](https://architecturetoautonomy.com/posts/the-seam-classical-ea-meets-agentic-governance.html): A six-layer pace-layered synthesis for agentic systems (L0 Constitution to L5 Evaluation) and the contract surface where it meets TOGAF, Zachman, and the classical enterprise estate.
- [Hardware Is Eating AI: The New Narrative Beyond Software Eating the World](https://architecturetoautonomy.com/posts/hardware-eating-ai-new-narrative.html): Why AI's dependence on physical infrastructure inverts the economics of the software era, and what the projected supply-demand data tells us about the 2025-2028 hardware shortage.
- [The Agentic Enterprise Needs a New Platform Stack](https://architecturetoautonomy.com/posts/agentic-enterprise-platform-stack.html): Why enterprises need a new architecture foundation for autonomous AI systems, covering delegation, verification, containment, and economics.
- [Agentic Operating Models for Enterprise Execution](https://architecturetoautonomy.com/posts/agentic-operating-models.html): Why agentic pilots stall in production without explicit ownership, autonomy boundaries, and lifecycle accountability.
- [Enterprise API Strategy for Platform Leverage](https://architecturetoautonomy.com/posts/enterprise-api-strategy.html): A practical API-as-product blueprint for domain alignment, federated governance, and agent-ready enterprise interfaces.
- [Cloud Modernization for AI-Ready Enterprise Platforms](https://architecturetoautonomy.com/posts/cloud-modernization-for-ai.html): How to evolve virtualization-era strengths into hybrid, governed, AI-ready platforms built for agentic execution.
- [Leading from Altitude: Why Strategic Distance Drives Better Decisions](https://architecturetoautonomy.com/posts/leading-from-altitude-strategic-distance.html): A leadership perspective on stepping back from daily noise to improve strategic clarity, decision quality, and team resilience.
- [From LAMP to LAMP: If It Ain't Broken, Don't Defend It](https://architecturetoautonomy.com/posts/from-lamp-aint-broken-dont-defend-samir-roshan-bibpc.html): A case for modernizing before legacy comfort turns into strategic drag, security exposure, and compounding technical debt.
- [Accelerating AI Transformation with VMware](https://architecturetoautonomy.com/posts/accelerating-ai-transformation-vmware-samir-roshan-vnoxc.html): A field-tested path for moving enterprise AI from pilots to production outcomes with platform discipline and governance.
- [The Foundation for Modern Private Cloud: Secure, Autonomous, and AI-Ready](https://architecturetoautonomy.com/posts/foundation-modern-private-cloud-secure-autonomous-ai-ready-roshan-gy0mc.html): Why modern private cloud is re-emerging as a core foundation for secure, governed, and autonomous AI-ready enterprise platforms.
- [Competitive Analysis: A Potent Tool for Understanding Market Dynamics](https://architecturetoautonomy.com/posts/competitive-analysis-potent-tool-understanding-market-samir-roshan.html): How disciplined competitive analysis sharpens positioning, uncovers market shifts early, and improves strategic execution.
- [The Platform Play: Driving Customer Experience by Creating Value](https://architecturetoautonomy.com/posts/platform-play-driving-customer-experience-creating-value-samir-roshan.html): Why platform strategy compounds customer experience, ecosystem leverage, and long-term differentiation.
- [The Rising Moon: Cost of Delayed Decisions](https://architecturetoautonomy.com/posts/rising-moon-cost-delayed-decisions-samir-roshan.html): Why delayed enterprise decisions quietly increase cost and risk, and how timely commitment preserves strategic momentum.
- [API Economy: Enabling Programmable Businesses](https://architecturetoautonomy.com/posts/api-economy-enabling-programmable-businesses-samir-roshan.html): How APIs transform capabilities into programmable products, enabling new business models and partnership-led growth.

## Apps

- [Neural Seed — Thesis-as-Code Deal Discovery for Solo Investors](https://architecturetoautonomy.com/assets/Tools/neural-seed/): Self-hosted, open-source (Apache-2.0) AI deal discovery for angels, scouts, and sector-focused VCs. Ingests public signals (GitHub trending, Hacker News Show HN, RSS), extracts company and founder data with Claude, and scores each company against a versioned Markdown thesis the user controls. Every score is traceable to the exact prompt bytes, model version, and source documents. Source: https://github.com/code4freedom/Neural_Seed
- [A2A Enterprise Agent Plane — Governed Agentic Operations for VCF](https://architecturetoautonomy.com/assets/Tools/agent-plane/): A reference implementation of agentic incident operations for VMware Cloud Foundation. Correlates evidence, evaluates policy, auto-executes low-risk actions, and holds higher-risk actions at an explicit approval gate with a replayable audit trail. Python/FastAPI, self-hosted, mock adapters by default. Source: https://github.com/code4freedom/a2a-enterprise-agent-plane
- [Whetstone — Free Practice Exams for AI Certifications](https://architecturetoautonomy.com/assets/Tools/whetstone/whetstone.html): A free, browser-based practice-exam app for AI certifications. 151 original items, 10 timed mock tests, custom-length runs, and targeted drills for the Claude Certified Architect – Foundations (CCAR-F) exam. No account, no install; results stored locally.
- [SkillsForge — Design Reusable AI Skill Bundles](https://code4freedom.github.io/a2a-skillsforge/): A web app for designing reusable AI skill bundles with live SKILL.md preview, validation, and ZIP export.
